plain_description.what: Simulates a new corpus arriving one question at a time. The tree files each question online (fixed leaf centres, a buffer for odd questions, periodic small rebuilds), and the result is compared with a full rebuild on the same six held-out corpora. No calls.
plain_description.why: It tests whether the tree can grow online without losing filing accuracy compared with rebuilding.
plain_description.information: Matching a rebuild would back the 'evolving tree' design. A loss would mean rebuilding is needed. Result: online filing is 3.3 points worse than a rebuild, so the warning test fired. The online design is not filing-neutral, and the claim narrows to 'stable ids at a filing cost; rebuild periodically'. The buffer also catches too few new questions (55%). One draw only.
